purpose: Durable "nothing got lost" proof for the asset-platform consolidation of PRs #26, #27, #28 and #29, plus the selective salvage of #11.

fixed_point.stacking: main -> #26 -> #27 -> {#28, #29}. Strictly linear, verified with git merge-base --is-ancestor.
fixed_point.owner_fit_baseline_note: Commit on feat/asset-forge (#27) at which the owner-locked Dawnwarden helmet and sword fit packets were authored. It is pinned as a literal in test/forge-owner-fit.test.mjs, so it survives the port unchanged and must NOT be rewritten to the consolidation head.

recovery_contract.statement: Every binary listed here is recoverable today without Google Drive. No source PR is closed and no source branch is modified, so every blob stays reachable on GitHub.
recovery_contract.verify: Hash the result with sha256 and compare against the sha256 field in this manifest.
recovery_contract.still_primary: The Google Drive archive is now a SECOND home for these bytes, not a replacement for this route. This contract stays in force and is deliberately not weakened: the git blob remains a valid, independent recovery path for as long as the source branches exist, which is why closing or deleting them is still an owner-controlled decision rather than a consequence of archival.

drive_archive.upload_state: COMPLETE for every binary this consolidation removed from Git. All 19 files (256,041,964 bytes) were uploaded on 2026-08-21 and each carries archive_status ARCHIVED_VERIFIED with a real Drive file id and URL. The 35 gear-family candidates are deliberately NOT here: they were never downloaded from the provider and remain identified by their Meshy task IDs only.

upload_verification_summary.note: Server-side md5Checksum is not exposed by the Drive connector available to this session; see archive_verification.md5_limitation on any archived item. Size was confirmed server-side and content was confirmed by reading every uploaded file back through the Drive mount.

drive_archive.access: Private to the owner Google account. The archive was NOT shared publicly or link-shared.

no_spend_declaration: This consolidation performed NO provider calls of any kind. No Meshy generation, rigging, animation, balance check, or status poll was issued, paid or read-only.

pr_11_salvage.head: 40b95c8101135b1503147203924b5f8212b5b2bd
pr_11_salvage.shape: Against main, PR #11 adds 1 file, deletes 30 and modifies 48. It introduces zero binaries. Most of that surface is not new work: the branch diverged before roughly sixteen merged PRs, so main is ahead of it almost everywhere.
pr_11_salvage.verdict: Nothing is ported. The tooling the brief hoped to salvage already exists on main in a strictly safer form.

surfaces.reason: Porting this would be a spend-safety REGRESSION, verified by reading both files. PR #11 awaits balance() at line 64, before the dry-run gate at line 69, so a "dry run" reads credentials and makes a live authenticated provider call. Main gates first: `if (!go)` at line 39 returns before the api/balance helpers at line 67, and its header states the dry run is "fully offline".
Same older generation of the client as image_to_3d.mjs; main already carries the guarded version.
Same older generation of the client; main already carries the guarded version.

Presents a session-scoped budget as standing permission ("The current owner authorization is up to 500 Meshy credits", plus a 35/60-credit sub-rule) and narrates the public repo as newly gaining clients it already has. test/guidance-integrity.test.mjs hard-bans the literal phrase "current owner authorization" in this file, so PR #11 would fail CI on merge. Main instead carries a "Credit budgets are not authority" section, which is the rule this consolidation is enforcing everywhere else.

The only genuinely new file on the branch. Kept as dated Warden art direction on its own unclosed branch rather than ported: no asset named beacon-warden exists in the current bank, which is the 13-enemy Wave 1 roster plus Bramble Stalker, and the brief hardcodes paths (tmp/warden-flat.png, public/assets/enemies/beacon_warden.glb) that do not exist. Landing it under docs/pipeline/ would also fail the guidance-integrity path scan. No Warden generation is authorised.

pr_11_salvage.remaining_surfaces: The other 74 changed paths are staleness rather than content: 30 files main has that the branch lacks, and 44 files where the branch holds an older revision. DO_NOT_PORT, because main is already ahead. The branch stays open and unmodified, so the history remains readable.
